{{Quote|This is Master Mobari. She led an attack against Ithorian terrorists but she was betrayed by her Padawan. He died in the same explosion that took her sight.|A'Sharad Hett to Anakin Skywalker on the attack|<ref name="Republic 58">[[Republic 58|''Republic'' 58]]</ref>}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Sora Mobari]] led an '''attack''' against [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] terrorists<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> on [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Plants and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, Mobari was betrayed by her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Evan-Ott]], who tried to kill his Master with an explosion only to end up being killed in the blast himself.<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> Master Mobari initially survived the blast with significant damage to her [[eye]]s and was transferred to a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] on the world [[New Holstice/Legends|New Holstice]]. There, Mobari succumbed to her injuries shortly after [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] shared the details of the attack to fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Republic 58" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack was first mentioned in the [[Republic 58|fifty&ndash;eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] written by [[W. Haden Blackman]]<ref name="Republic 58" /> and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[December 17]], [[2003]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-204/Star-Wars-Republic-58The-Battle-of-Jabiim-Part-4-of-4|text=Star Wars: Republic #58 The Battle of Jabiim (Part 4 of 4)}}</ref>
